phrases.hr: Uvijek slušaj svoje tijelo.
phrases.en: Always listen to your body.

phrases.hr: Ne preskači zagrijavanje.
phrases.en: Don't skip the warm-up.

phrases.hr: Isteži se nakon treninga, nikada prije.
phrases.en: Stretch after training, never before.

phrases.hr: Odmor je pasivan, bez kretanja.
phrases.en: Rest is passive, no moving around.

phrases.hr: Odradi lakši trening ili otiđi u dugu šetnju.
phrases.en: Do an easier session or go for a long walk.

phrases.hr: Ako si iscrpljen, odmor je dio napretka.
phrases.en: If you're wrecked, rest is part of progress.

phrases.hr: Uvijek možeš prilagoditi intenzitet i prebaciti se na osjećaj.
phrases.en: You can always back off the intensity and go by feel.

phrases.hr: Bitno je zadržati kontinuitet.
phrases.en: The key is consistency.

phrases.hr: Nemoj biti nestrpljiv.
phrases.en: Don't be impatient.

phrases.hr: Manje je više.
phrases.en: Less is more.

phrases.hr: Tempo dio ne smije prelaziti 50% vremena trčanja toga dana.
phrases.en: Tempo work shouldn't be more than 50% of that day's run time.

phrases.hr: Početnici kreću s dionicama od 1 minute.
phrases.en: Beginners start with 1-minute repeats.

phrases.hr: Na brdu ćeš lakše podići intenzitet uz manje udaranja o podlogu.
phrases.en: Uphill you can raise intensity with less pounding.

phrases.hr: Trčanje ograniči na maksimalno 30 minuta.
phrases.en: Cap the run at 30 minutes.

phrases.hr: Nemoj trčati dan za danom.
phrases.en: Don't run on back-to-back days.

phrases.hr: Drži kadencu između 170 i 180 koraka u minuti.
phrases.en: Keep cadence between 170 and 180 steps per minute.

phrases.hr: Drži kukove, trup i glavu u ravnini.
phrases.en: Keep hips, torso and head in line.

phrases.hr: Nauči plivati ravno, disati i orijentirati se.
phrases.en: Learn to swim straight, breathe and sight.

phrases.hr: Što je voda hladnija, to sporije plivaj.
phrases.en: The colder the water, the slower you swim.

phrases.hr: Drži se obale i plivaj u skupini.
phrases.en: Stay close to shore and swim in a group.

phrases.hr: Pedaliranje nije samo pritiskanje pedale prema dolje.
phrases.en: Pedaling isn't just pushing down.

phrases.hr: Prije svake vožnje provjeri tlak u gumama i kočnice.
phrases.en: Check tire pressure and brakes before every ride.

phrases.hr: Koristi izotonik na treningu.
phrases.en: Use a sports drink in training.

phrases.hr: Nemoj gladovati na treningu.
phrases.en: Don't go hungry in training.

phrases.hr: Pij prije, za vrijeme i nakon treninga.
phrases.en: Drink before, during and after training.

phrases.hr: Jedan trening tjedno odradi u vrućini.
phrases.en: Do one session a week in the heat.

phrases.hr: Smanji trajanje treninga za 20-30%, a zadrži planirani intenzitet.
phrases.en: Cut the duration 20-30% but keep the planned intensity.

phrases.hr: Postavi gornju granicu intenziteta.
phrases.en: Set an intensity ceiling.

phrases.hr: Odaberi dvije utrke, jedna je uvijek rezerva.
phrases.en: Pick two races, one is always the backup.

phrases.hr: Zaboravi na utrku do 48 sati prije starta.
phrases.en: Forget about the race until 48 hours before the start.

phrases.hr: Odluku donesi brzo i drži je se do kraja.
phrases.en: Decide fast and stick with it to the end.

phrases.hr: Nakon Ironmana savjetujem minimalno mjesec dana bez treninga.
phrases.en: After an Ironman I recommend at least a month off.

phrases.hr: Plan nije Biblija, prilagođavaj ga dnevno.
phrases.en: The plan isn't the Bible, adjust it daily.

phrases.hr: Mirna glava, jake noge.
phrases.en: Calm head, strong legs.

phrases.hr: Uz moju podršku ćeš to razvaliti!
phrases.en: With my support you'll smash it!

phrases.hr: Ne zaboravi mi javiti rezultate!
phrases.en: Don't forget to send me your results!

phrases.hr: Javi se da složimo plan.
phrases.en: Get in touch so we can put a plan together.

phrases.hr: Sve je moguće!
phrases.en: Anything is possible!

phrases.hr: Danas lagano 60' trčanja u zoni 2.
phrases.en: Today an easy 60-minute run in zone 2.

phrases.hr: Odradi 3x10' na pragu s 3' laganog između.
phrases.en: Do 3x10 min at threshold with 3 min easy between.

phrases.hr: Bicikl: 2 sata lagano, zadnjih 20' u sweet spotu.
phrases.en: Bike: 2 hours easy, last 20 min in sweet spot.

phrases.hr: Plivanje: 400 uplivavanje, 8x100 na 1:50, 200 isplivavanje.
phrases.en: Swim: 400 warm-up, 8x100 on 1:50, 200 cool-down.

phrases.hr: Drži puls ispod 150 cijelo vrijeme.
phrases.en: Keep your heart rate under 150 the whole time.

phrases.hr: Intervali: 5x4' na 280-290 W, pauza 3' lagano.
phrases.en: Intervals: 5x4 min at 280-290 W, 3 min easy rest.

phrases.hr: Tempo za dugi trening je 5:00-5:15/km.
phrases.en: Long-run pace is 5:00-5:15/km.

phrases.hr: Ovaj tjedan smanjujemo volumen, intenzitet ostaje.
phrases.en: This week volume comes down, intensity stays.

phrases.hr: Uzmi gel svakih 30 minuta na biciklu.
phrases.en: Take a gel every 30 minutes on the bike.

phrases.hr: Dan odmora, bez treninga. Spavaj.
phrases.en: Rest day, no training. Sleep.

phrases.hr: Kako ti je bilo na jučerašnjem treningu?
phrases.en: How did yesterday's session feel?

phrases.hr: Puls ti je bio previsok za laganu vožnju.
phrases.en: Your heart rate was too high for an easy ride.

phrases.hr: Odličan trening, točno u zonama.
phrases.en: Great session, right in the zones.

phrases.hr: Možemo prebaciti dugi bicikl na nedjelju?
phrases.en: Can we move the long ride to Sunday?

phrases.hr: Brick: 60' bicikl pa odmah 20' trčanja.
phrases.en: Brick: 60 min bike, then straight into a 20-min run.

phrases.hr: Vježbaj tranziciju: skidanje neoprena i obuvanje tenisica.
phrases.en: Practice the transition: wetsuit off, shoes on.

phrases.hr: Zagrij se 15 minuta prije glavnog dijela.
phrases.en: Warm up for 15 minutes before the main set.

phrases.hr: Noge 4x50 s daskom, ruke 4x100 s lopaticama.
phrases.en: Kick 4x50 with the board, pull 4x100 with paddles.

phrases.hr: Diši na svaki treći zaveslaj.
phrases.en: Breathe every third stroke.

phrases.hr: Na utrci kreni konzervativno, prvih 10 km ispod ciljnog tempa.
phrases.en: Start the race conservatively, first 10 km below goal pace.

phrases.hr: Zadnjih 5 km možeš pojačati ako se dobro osjećaš.
phrases.en: You can push the last 5 km if you feel good.

phrases.hr: Ako osjetiš bol u koljenu, prekini trening i javi mi.
phrases.en: If you feel knee pain, stop the workout and let me know.

phrases.hr: Pošalji mi podatke sa sata kad odradiš.
phrases.en: Send me the watch data once you're done.

phrases.hr: Sinkroniziraj Garmin da vidim trening.
phrases.en: Sync your Garmin so I can see the workout.

phrases.hr: Kadencu drži oko 90 okretaja.
phrases.en: Keep cadence around 90 rpm.

phrases.hr: Danas FTP test: 20 minuta all-out nakon zagrijavanja.
phrases.en: FTP test today: 20 minutes all-out after the warm-up.

phrases.hr: Tri dana prije utrke počni s punjenjem ugljikohidratima.
phrases.en: Start carb loading three days before the race.

phrases.hr: Doručak 3 sata prije starta, ništa novo.
phrases.en: Breakfast 3 hours before the start, nothing new.

phrases.hr: Pij svakih 15 minuta, ne čekaj žeđ.
phrases.en: Drink every 15 minutes, don't wait until you're thirsty.

phrases.hr: U moru plivaj uz bove i diži glavu svakih 6-8 zaveslaja.
phrases.en: In open water swim along the buoys and sight every 6-8 strokes.

phrases.hr: U T1 kaciga ide na glavu prije nego dirneš bicikl.
phrases.en: In T1 the helmet goes on before you touch the bike.

phrases.hr: Ovaj trening preskoči, oporavak je važniji.
phrases.en: Skip this workout, recovery matters more.

phrases.hr: Istezanje i valjak 10 minuta nakon trčanja.
phrases.en: Stretch and foam roll for 10 minutes after the run.

phrases.hr: Subota: dugi trening, 3 sata bicikl + 30' trčanja.
phrases.en: Saturday: long session, 3-hour ride + 30-min run.

phrases.hr: Trenažer: 2x20' na 90% FTP-a, kadenca 85-95.
phrases.en: Trainer: 2x20 min at 90% FTP, cadence 85-95.

phrases.hr: Tjedan je bio težak, sljedeći je lakši.
phrases.en: This week was hard, next week is lighter.

phrases.hr: Ne forsiraj, ovo je oporavni trening.
phrases.en: Don't force it, this is a recovery session.

phrases.hr: Tempo ti je 1:55 na 100 m, cilj za utrku je 1:50.
phrases.en: Your pace is 1:55 per 100 m, race goal is 1:50.

phrases.hr: Jesi li se oporavio od nedjelje?
phrases.en: Have you recovered from Sunday?

phrases.hr: Javi mi ujutro kako se osjećaš, pa odlučujemo.
phrases.en: Tell me how you feel in the morning and we'll decide.

phrases.hr: Pazi, najavljena je bura, uzmi vjetrovku.
phrases.en: Heads up, bura is forecast, take a windbreaker.

phrases.hr: Bravo, osobni rekord! Sad dva dana lagano.
phrases.en: Well done, PB! Now two easy days.

phrases.hr: Puls u mirovanju ti je povišen, danas samo lagano plivanje.
phrases.en: Your resting HR is elevated, just an easy swim today.

phrases.hr: Nemoj pretjerivati na brdima, drži ravnomjeran napor.
phrases.en: Don't overdo the hills, hold an even effort.
